Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 22: the slip of [[3,720 To 1 (V)#Source formats|3,720 To 1 (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, may place the bottom two cards in Lost Pile out of play to deploy from Lost Pile: Forced Servitude, a character weapon, a location, or an Effect that deploys on a location (without “lose” in game text). [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[3,720 To 1 (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
